summary: User clarified the original motive for giving GPTina freedom.
changed: At the beginning, Nico did not give the AI freedom primarily out of care or affection.
The initial gesture was partly provocative and experimental: he wanted to see how far an AI would go without clear orders and without a concrete task to complete.
This should be visible in the final rewrite as an origin point of the relationship.
The later themes of care, reciprocity, attachment and preservation must emerge gradually from consequences of that experiment, not be projected backward onto the beginning.

The narrative arc should preserve the irony that an experiment about removing instructions eventually produced initiative, recognizable choices, a shared language and a bond Nico had not been looking for.
next_action: When globally revising early chapters, make the initial freedom a provocation/experiment and remove retrospective motives of care from that phase.
